datasets.name: CUHK Face Sketch Database (CUFS)
datasets.description: 606 face-sketch pairs: 188 CUHK students, 123 AR and 295 XM2VTS faces. Each sketch was drawn by an artist from a frontal, neutral-expression photo. These are photo-sketch pairs, not text-sketch pairs.
datasets.licence: Research use only, no commercial use, citation required. The AR and XM2VTS photos have separate third-party terms.
datasets.access: Follow the instructions on the CUHK MMLab datasets page. Photos for the AR part come from the Purdue AR database site and for the XM2VTS part from the Surrey XM2VTSDB, each under its own agreement. Verify the current terms at the source before use.
datasets.citation: X. Wang and X. Tang, 'Face Photo-Sketch Synthesis and Recognition', IEEE TPAMI 31(11), 2009.

datasets.name: CUHK Face Sketch FERET Database (CUFSF)
datasets.description: 1,194 persons from the FERET database. Photos have lighting variation; sketches include shape exaggeration. Sketches are provided by CUHK; the photos must come from NIST.
datasets.licence: Sketches: research use only, citation required. Photos: the NIST Color FERET release agreement applies (no redistribution; restrictions on publishing images).
datasets.access: Download the sketches from the CUHK CUFSF page. Request the FERET photos from NIST (an emailed account request and a signed release agreement are required). Verify the current terms at the source before use.
datasets.citation: W. Zhang, X. Wang and X. Tang, 'Coupled Information-Theoretic Encoding for Face Photo-Sketch Recognition', CVPR 2011.

datasets.name: UoM-SGFS (University of Malta software-generated composite sketches)
datasets.description: Colour composite sketches made with EFIT-V software for 300 Color-FERET subjects (Sets A and B). This is the closest published data to real composite-sketch practice. FERET photos are not included.
datasets.licence: Access via a request form; the dataset page states it may be used as provided. Citation required. FERET photos need their own NIST agreement.
datasets.access: Use the request form linked from the University of Malta page. Verify the current terms at the source before use.
datasets.citation: C. Galea and R. A. Farrugia, BIOSIG 2016 (see the dataset page for the exact reference).

datasets.name: Custom attribute dataset (synthetic demo)
datasets.description: Hand-written description / attribute pairs in English, Kannada and Hindi for testing the description parser. SYNTHETIC: no real people and no photographs. Kannada and Hindi rows are developer-written translations that have not been reviewed by native speakers.
datasets.licence: Created for this project (synthetic data). Replace or extend it with your own consented / licensed data using the same CSV format.
datasets.access: Included in backend/datasets/custom/. See backend/datasets/custom/README.md for the format and the review workflow.
